title: Gurukul AI: An Interactive AI-Driven Educational Platform for Indian Education System
abstract: arXiv:2608.28611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT and LLaMA have transformed AI-driven education, but these systems are predominantly trained on Western-centric data, making them ill-suited for regional curricula like India's. The Indian education system is linguistically diverse, exam-oriented, and structured around standardized syllabi, not addressed by existing datasets or tools. In this work, we curate a syllabus-aligned QA dataset based on NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) textbooks for classes 9-12, capturing the content, context, and teaching style of Indian curricula. The final dataset, comprising 18,720 question-answer pairs across five subjects, is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/Gurukul. We fine-tune the LLaMA 3.1 8B model using this dataset and deploy it in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework tailored to educational needs. We introduce Guru

translated_title: Gurukul AI：面向印度教育体系的交互式AI驱动教育平台
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.28611v1 公告类型：cross（交叉）摘要：近年来，以ChatGPT和LLaMA为代表的大型语言模型（LLM）的进步改变了AI驱动的教育领域，但这些系统主要基于以西方为中心的数据进行训练，因此并不适用于印度等地区的课程体系。印度教育体系语言多样、以考试为导向，并围绕标准化教学大纲构建，而现有数据集或工具均未涉及这一特点。在本研究中，我们基于NCERT（国家教育研究与培训委员会）9至12年级教科书，构建了一个与教学大纲对齐的问答数据集，捕捉了印度课程的内容、语境和教学风格。最终的数据集涵盖五个学科、共包含18,720个问答对，已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/Gurukul 公开发布。我们使用该数据集对LLaMA 3.1 8B模型进行微调，并将其部署在专为教育需求定制的检索增强生成（RAG）框架中。我们介绍了Guru……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是构建了基于印度NCERT教科书、与教学大纲对齐的18,720条五学科问答数据集，并据此微调LLaMA 3.1 8B模型，在检索增强生成（RAG）框架下打造了专为印度教育体系服务的交互式教育平台Gurukul AI。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is the curation of an NCERT syllabus-aligned QA dataset of 18,720 pairs across five subjects for the Indian education system, used to fine-tune LLaMA 3.1 8B within a RAG framework to build Gurukul AI, an interactive educational platform.
